data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Can people sign a waiver when they book?
Yes. Add a waiver form to the event: the terms, an acknowledgement and a signature, kept as a receipt.
You and the leads you give access to for that event. Nobody else.
Does Catch track people on the trail?
No. Leads mark who’s with them at each regroup and at the end. Catch shows you anyone not marked.
Can leads use their own phones?
Yes. Give each lead access for the event; it ends when the event does.
No. Add pick-up points and times to the event, and they go out in the reminder.
No. They book, sign and check in in their phone’s browser.
